titolo: New AI Wearables Launch: Bee Frontier, Friend 2.0, Omi and More
descr: Several AI‑powered pendants, wristbands and pocket devices debut this week, ranging from $49.99 to $249 and offering transcription, personal‑assistant and emotional‑support features.
paragrafi: TechCrunch reports a wave of AI wearables released on October 25, 2026, targeting productivity, companionship and personal growth.
Friend 2.0, a $129 white pendant, adds a built‑in speaker for voice interaction and claims to act as an emotional‑support companion.
Limitless, formerly Rewind, is a $99 pendant that records and transcribes meetings, offering 10 hours of AI features per month with an optional $29 unlimited plan.
Other notable devices include Omi at $89, which runs conversations through ChatGPT, and Nirva at $249, a growth‑focused pendant slated for November orders.
perche: These devices illustrate how AI is moving from cloud‑only services to always‑on, on‑body hardware, expanding use cases beyond desktop chat.
